city.Vanuatu.description: This nation of about 80 islands in the South Pacific is known for its rumbling volcanoes, coral reefs, and the vine-jumping tradition that inspired bungee jumping.
city.Vanuatu.landmark: glowing lava explosions of Mount Yasur volcano at dusk
city.Vanuatu.greeting: Most people speak Bislama, a playful cousin of English — say hello with “halo” (HAH-loh).
city.Vanuatu.flag: red and green with a black triangle and a little curled boar's tusk
city.Vanuatu.clue.0: couldn't wait to climb a volcano and peer down into its glowing, bubbling top
city.Vanuatu.clue.1: kept talking about a place where people leap from tall wooden towers with vines tied to their feet — the very first bungee jump
